title: Token introspection calls each emit one structured audit event on the fixed allow-list
asA: operator running the runtime-verify suite against the introspection client
iWant: every introspect call to write one structured `keycloak.introspection` event carrying only the allow-list fields
soThat: the audit stream stays free of the introspection response body and every refusal carries a stable reasonClass

acceptanceCriteria.description: An introspect call whose response is `active: true` emits exactly one `keycloak.introspection` event carrying `outcome=verified` and the caller's realm slug.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint response is a `200 { active: true, ... }` against realm `alpha`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client introspects the token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose own-property keys are exactly `{family, outcome, realmSlug, at}` with `family=keycloak.introspection` and `outcome=verified`; the introspection response body, the token value, the client secret, and any substring of the above are not present in any field

acceptanceCriteria.description: An introspect call whose response is `active: false` or a non-2xx status emits exactly one refused event carrying a `reasonClass`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint response is `200 { active: false }` or a 5xx status against realm `alpha`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client introspects the token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly one event whose `outcome=refused` and `reasonClass` is a stable-coded string (for example `inactive` or `upstream_error`); the event carries `family=keycloak.introspection`, `realmSlug=alpha`, and `at`; the introspection response body is not present

acceptanceCriteria.description: A transient introspection failure followed by a successful retry emits exactly one refused event and one verified event on the `keycloak.introspection` family, in order; the retry itself is not a distinct event.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a token whose introspection endpoint returns 503 on the first attempt and 200 with `active: true` on the second
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client retries per its documented posture and completes the call
acceptanceCriteria.then: the audit sink records exactly two events in order: one `keycloak.introspection` event with `outcome=refused` and a reasonClass value, then one `keycloak.introspection` event with `outcome=verified`; no additional event is written for the retry itself

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sink failure during the emission of a `keycloak.introspection` event does not mask the underlying introspection outcome; the mechanism records a `keycloak.audit_sink_failed` warning event and the introspection outcome is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an introspect call whose response is `active: true` and an audit sink whose write throws
acceptanceCriteria.when: the introspection client emits the completion event
acceptanceCriteria.then: the client's return value still reports the underlying introspection result unchanged; the mechanism records a `keycloak.audit_sink_failed` warning event carrying the realm slug and a reason-class string; the introspection response body does not appear
